verifications.claim: April 15, 2026 is the deadline for most Americans to file their 2025 federal income tax returns.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'For 2025 returns filed in 2026, the last day to file taxes is April 15, 2026.'; R7: 'U.S. income taxes for tax year 2025 are due Wednesday, April 15, 2026.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state April 15, 2026 as filing deadline for 2025 returns.

verifications.claim: April 15, 2026 is the deadline for most Americans to pay any taxes owed.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'The deadline for paying taxes is midnight on April 15'; R6: 'Taxes are still owed by April 15'; R7: 'Taxes for 2025 are due April 15, 2026.'
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently confirm April 15, 2026 as payment deadline for taxes owed.

verifications.claim: Tax returns must be postmarked or electronically submitted by April 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'If you file via mail, the IRS will consider your return filed on time if it was postmarked by the due date.'; R2: 'mail Form 4868, but it must be postmarked by April 15'; R10: 'it must be postmarked by April 15.'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly describe postmark or electronic submission by April 15 as timely.

verifications.claim: IRS Form 4868 provides an automatic six-month extension.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'fill out Form 4868 by April 15. Filing this form will give filers an additional 6 months'; R4: 'automatic six-month extension ... by submitting IRS Form 4868'; R2: 'filing a tax extension via Form 4868'.
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state Form 4868 provides automatic 6-month extension.

verifications.claim: The six-month extension shifts the filing deadline to October 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'until Tuesday, Oct. 15'; R4: 'the due date to file with extension is Oct. 15'; R5: 'until Thursday, Oct. 15'; R7: 'six-month extension ... to Oct. 15, 2026'.
verifications.reasoning: All sources agree extension moves filing to October 15, 2026 (minor day-of-week variance irrelevant to claim).

verifications.claim: Taxes owed must still be paid by April 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'you still must pay taxes by the original April 15 deadline'; R4: 'not more time to pay your taxes. So ... payments are due on Tax Day'; R6: 'Taxes are still owed by April 15'.
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state taxes owed due by April 15 despite extension.

verifications.claim: Filing an extension does not provide more time to pay taxes owed.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'an extension only gives you more time to submit your tax return forms, not more time to pay your taxes'; R2: 'extension ... But you still must pay taxes by the original April 15 deadline'; R6: 'an extension to file is not an extension to pay taxes.'
verifications.reasoning: Direct statements in sources confirm extension applies only to filing, not payment.

verifications.claim: Missing the deadline without an extension can result in penalties of 5% of unpaid taxes per month, up to 25%.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'failure-to-file penalty is 5% of your unpaid taxes monthly, up to 25%'; R5: 'standard penalty is 5% of any tax due for every month ... up to 25%'; R6: '5% of the tax owed each month ... maximum of 25%'; R10: '5% of the unpaid tax per month, capped at 25%'.
verifications.reasoning: Exact penalty details match across multiple sources.

verifications.claim: Residents of Maine and Massachusetts have until April 17, 2026, to file due to the Patriots' Day holiday.
